description: The amateur satellite index on the AMSAT website lists the radio frequencies of amateur satellites orbiting Earth and lets users search and sort them by name, number and mode. The data are compiled by Mineo Wakita (JE9PEL) and Ben Welsh, with links from each entry to the corresponding SatNOGS database record, and machine-readable data files are available for download from the project's GitHub repository. The page states that data drawn from the SatNOGS database is available under a Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 licence. Caveats: coverage is limited to amateur (radio amateur and educational) satellites, and the frequencies are those coordinated or reported for amateur use, not a full satellite catalogue. It is useful as a register of small satellites and their downlink frequencies for studies of space infrastructure, ground-station networks and interference, and for hazard exposure analysis of space assets; the related record data-satnogs-db holds the crowdsourced satellite and transmitter database the index links to.
licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (SatNOGS-derived data, as stated on the page)
